output.summary: Annual plant native to most of Europe, northern Africa and western Asia, typically occurring on cultivated or disturbed ground. It has smooth stems, green flowers and kidney-shaped glands with long, thin horns. Its whole plant, including the root, was formerly eaten as Polish famine food after boiling in milk.
output.edibilityNote: In Poland, the whole plant, including its root, was formerly eaten as famine food after being boiled in milk.
